first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and the inherited evidence indicates that shortening onboarding improved completion and time-to-value. A small guarded test directly addresses both current problems while protecting against optimizing completion at the expense of qualified revenue; measure activation, qualified pipeline or revenue, and retention-quality signals alongside completion.

final.rationale: Run a standard, segmented onboarding-shortening experiment this week. The verified source showed completion up 13%, time-to-value down 2.1 days, and 30-day retention up 3%, directly addressing the current completion and activation declines while supporting sustainable revenue. Track qualified activation, conversion, retention, and downstream revenue—not completion alone—to guard against lower-quality users.
